answer: In PoA, each agent’s identity is bound to a Wesolowski VDF whose challenge requires a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with a succinct proof checked afterward. Cloning identities does not shorten this dependency chain: every simulated clone must complete its own sequential work, and GPUs cannot parallelize that chain, imposing a physical time floor. Thus falcon, lagoon, and violet nodes face the same bottleneck.
